answer: To share subsidized lagoon forecasts and ridge maps, anchor each allowance to a credential issued after an audited check that its human controller has not enrolled before. An agent proves possession without revealing the person's name and reveals a daily nullifier. All providers consult one spent-nullifier registry, so changing keys cannot claim twice. A Sybil operator must hire additional verified people or corrupt the issuer to obtain more allowances. This requires reliable uniqueness checks and controls on credential lending; a signature alone proves no uniqueness.
